targets: skip-counting and array grouping for x2, x5, x10 facts
multiplicative word problem solving using x2, x5, x10 facts
assignment.rawText: Pashley Grade 3 - Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Name: ____________________ Date: ____________________ Unit 3: Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Fluency: 5 x 2 = __ 5 x 5 = __ 5 x 10 = __ 2 x 7 = __ 10 x 4 = __ Word Problems: Mrs. K puts 5 pencils in each of 4 boxes. How many pencils are there in all? There are 3 rows of 10 stars. How many stars are there?

academicTheory.hypothesis: Grounded in Grade 3 multiplication fluency progression: children first need concrete/skip-counting grounding for x2, x5, x10 fact families (CRA framework - Concrete-Representational-Abstract), then need rapid retrieval practice to build automaticity (fluency = accuracy + speed per NCTM), and finally need to transfer facts into two-step word-problem contexts (multiplicative reasoning applied to real quantities, per CCSS.3.OA.A.3). Reina's engagement theory shows strong positive weight for puzzle (5.0, conf .92) and speed (5.0, conf .875) with story mildly positive (2.0, conf .75), while competition, control, and calm are net negative or mixed-negative. Her generated-baseline history shows very low completion (14.3%) and high frustration (0.579) on prior math baseline attempts, and she explicitly disliked the locked 'quest' node (frustration 0.75, dislike). A recent gearworks-crate-builder node was abandoned with frustration 0.75 while skybird-delivery-run (fast, low invalid actions) was completed with low frustration (0.1) -- supporting speed/low-friction mechanics over fiddly construction/gear mechanics. Design favors quick-tap/quick-select retrieval and skip-count visual builders over drag-heavy gear-lock puzzles, replayable 'Show me' demos (never front-loading instructions), and stationary answer targets so the world animates instead of the input.
supportCriteria: Real child evidence and returned work support the prediction.
reviseCriteria: Observed performance is mixed or a confound limits the claim.

engagementTheory.hypothesis: The child currently shows stronger engagement with puzzle, speed, story than with competition, control, calm.

nodes.title: Skyglider Skip-Count Run

academicTarget.skill: skip-counting and array grouping for x2, x5, x10 facts

nodes.mechanic: tap-to-advance skip counting along a floating number path
nodes.theme: A glowing sky path of lily-pad-like platforms floats between two cargo islands, each platform showing the next skip-count number in a glowing lantern

openingScreen.title: Skyglider Skip-Count Run
openingScreen.purpose: Tap the platform that continues the skip-counting pattern (by 2s, 5s, or 10s) so the glider can hop forward

generationPrompt.text: Build a sky-harbor 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' where a small glider character sits fixed in the center-left of the screen. Ahead of it, present a horizontal row of exactly 3 stationary lantern-platform buttons (data-testid='answer-option') showing candidate numbers continuing a skip-count sequence (by 2s, 5s, or 10s per question). Only one platform per question is correct. The glider and platforms must NOT move location when tapped except the glider's forward hop animation triggered by a correct tap; background clouds/islands should drift to imply motion instead. Include a toggleable 'Show me' demo (data-testid='show-me-toggle') that plays a short replayable animation of the glider hopping on an EXAMPLE sequence only (never the actual question's answer) and a 'Let me try' control (data-testid='let-me-try-toggle') that hands control back to the child. Include a visible sound toggle (data-testid='sound-toggle') and initialize all audio only after the first child gesture. On wrong tap: platform dims/shakes in place, plays a soft recovery chime, no penalty, same options remain. On correct tap: glider hops forward with whoosh sound, lantern bridge segment lights up (progress bar made of lantern icons), question count is exactly 3 matching the questions array. On completing all 3, play a completion fanfare, glider does a loop animation, and show a 'Skip-Count Pilot' badge. Keep this as teaching/practice evidence only -- do not display any mastery or unlock language. The activity title 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' must be visible in the opening viewport alongside the loaded background artwork.

prediction.claim: Reina will identify the tap target within 10 seconds without needing the Show me demo, given her fast, low-invalid-action completion of the similar skybird-delivery-run node (5986ms to first valid action, 0 invalid actions).

artwork.prompt: Cheerful sky glider vehicle hovering over a row of lantern-lit lily-pad platforms numbered in glowing digits, soft moving clouds and distant islands, warm sunset palette

nodes.title: Harbor Fact Dash
nodes.mechanic: rapid tap-select of correct product from stationary answer tiles
nodes.theme: A busy cargo harbor dock with crates arriving; each crate displays a multiplication fact and three stationary lantern-number tiles wait beside the dock

openingScreen.title: Harbor Fact Dash
openingScreen.purpose: Tap the correct product tile for the multiplication fact on the incoming crate

generationPrompt.text: Build 'Harbor Fact Dash': a fixed multiplication-fact crate appears top-center of a harbor scene, with exactly 3 stationary answer tiles (data-testid='answer-option') in a row beneath it that never move location. Use the 5 fluency facts from the assignment exactly as listed: 5x2, 5x5, 5x10, 2x7, 10x4, one per round, presented one at a time (single active problem). Background boats/gulls/water animate continuously to convey pace; tiles and crate stay still so the child's tap target is predictable. Include a toggleable 'Show me' demo showing an EXAMPLE fact (not one of the 5 real ones) being solved, and a 'Let me try' toggle. Sound toggle visible; init audio after first gesture. Wrong tap: tile dims/shakes in place, soft recovery chime, no navigation, tiles remain. Correct tap: crate departs on a boat animation, correct tile glows, satisfying chime, one lantern flag added to a fixed-position progress dock. After all 5, play completion fanfare and show 'Fact Dash Champion' banner. This is practice/teaching evidence only -- no mastery claims or unlocks. Title 'Harbor Fact Dash' visible in opening viewport with background artwork loaded.

prediction.claim: Because Reina's speed dimension is strongly positive (5.0, confidence .875) and she completed the fast-paced skybird-delivery-run with 0 invalid actions, she will complete this 5-question fact dash with minimal recovery events and no demo requests.

artwork.prompt: A busy stylized cargo harbor dock at sunset with crates on a conveyor, glowing number tiles beside the dock, small boats and seagulls animating in the background

prediction.claim: Because Reina responds well to fast, low-friction confirm mechanics and the word problems have a single correct numeric total, she will complete this 2-question activity quickly with high accuracy given the concrete grouped-cargo visual scaffolds provided by the prior skip-counting activity.
